summary: Designer & luxury eyewear + sunglass-case-as-collectible category. Covers brands NOT already routed via Louis Vuitton / Coach vintage / Cartier accessories / Designer luxury / Ray-Ban entries. Two surprising apex sub-tiers: (1) Chrome Hearts black-leather sunglass cases trade $349-$1,259 STANDALONE — the case alone, no sunglasses inside. (2) Bentley Continental GT/GTC OEM carbon-fiber console glove-box cases trade $350-$1,249. Premium-eyewear brands like Jacques Marie Mage / Persol Ratti / Tom Ford / Oliver Peoples / DITA / Jean Lafont Paris / Gentle Monster (GM) / Tiffany / Miu Miu / Christian Louboutin / Valentino Garavani / Saint Laurent / Balmain / Brighton / BAPE / Harveys Seatbelt Barbie. eBay sold-listings (Last Year): Sunglass Cases-Accessories category $0.82-$670 / 1,100 sellers / avg $25.89; Eyeglass Cases & Storage category $0.01-$1,259 / 19,836 sellers / avg $16.25. Strict ship_class: poly_mailer / small_box. CRITICAL: Empty-case-alone is a real apex tier — don't dismiss as 'just an empty case'.

brands.notes: Chrome Hearts eyewear is the apex collector tier. The case ALONE trades $349-$1,259 — buyers want it to pair with sunglasses they already own. Verify Stirling Silver scroll logo + black leather construction + Made-in-Japan. Real Chrome Hearts cases have heavy weight, dense suede inner lining, and silver-stamped scroll logos that pass UV-light checks. Counterfeit risk is HIGH so buy only with authentication chain. Sunglass models (SOFFFFFFFFERS II / Lordie / Lowrider 925 / Jackwacker 2 / Slag / Deep I / Tycoxagain / Pawsmuc / See You In Tea / Pony Hair) clear $1,100-$2,750 NIB w/case.
